subject: Английский язык
authors: Вербицкая М. В., Эббс Б., Уорелл Э., Уорд Э., Оралова О. В.

chapters.title: 15. С днём рождения, Джил! Happy birthday, Jill!

problems.condition: Урок 15, упр. 1, с. 4. Послушай и прочитай историю «Happy birthday, Jill!».
steps: У Джилл день рождения, ей девять лет. Дедушка: Happy birthday, Jill! How old are you today? Джилл: I'm nine. Все дарят подарки.
problems.answer: Jill is nine today.

problems.condition: Урок 15, упр. 2, с. 5. Прочитай историю по ролям.
steps: Grandpa: Happy birthday, Jill! How old are you today? Jill: I'm nine. Thank you!
problems.answer: Happy birthday! How old are you? — I'm nine.

problems.condition: Урок 15, упр. 3, с. 6. Послушай запись: сколько кому лет?
steps: Dan is eight. Sarah is ten. Alice is seven. Yasmin is six. Peter is nine.
problems.answer: Dan — 8, Sarah — 10, Alice — 7, Yasmin — 6, Peter — 9

problems.condition: Урок 15, упр. 4, с. 6. Спросите друг друга, сколько лет ребятам.
steps: How old is Dan? — He's eight. How old is Sarah? — She's ten. How old is Alice? — She's seven. How old is Yasmin? — She's six. How old is Peter? — He's nine.
problems.answer: How old is …? — He's / She's …

problems.condition: Урок 15, упр. 5, с. 6. Послушай и покажи, кто из детей рассказывает о себе.
steps: Dan, Sarah, Peter, Yasmin.
problems.answer: Dan, Sarah, Peter, Yasmin

problems.condition: Урок 15, упр. 6, с. 6. Поздравьте друг друга с днём рождения по образцу.
steps: How old are you, Masha? — I'm nine. — Happy birthday! — Thank you very much.
problems.answer: How old are you? — I'm … — Happy birthday! — Thank you.

problems.condition: Урок 15, упр. 7, с. 7. Как читается буква U в открытом слоге?
steps: /juː/: music, computer, use.
problems.answer: /juː/ — music

problems.condition: Урок 15, упр. 8, с. 7. Прочитай слова: как ещё может читаться U?
steps: В закрытом слоге U — /ʌ/: mum, up, nut. ur — /ɜː/: fur, surf, turn. ou — /aʊ/: house, mouse.
problems.answer: /ʌ/ mum; /ɜː/ fur; /aʊ/ house

problems.condition: Урок 15, упр. 9, с. 7. Послушай и прочитай слова.
steps: music, computer, use; mum, up, nut, number; burger, fur, surf, turn; house, mouse, ground, mount.
problems.answer: music, computer, use, mum, up, nut, number, burger, fur, surf, turn, house, mouse, ground, mount

problems.condition: Урок 15, упр. 10, с. 7. Какой праздник любит Никита? Расскажи о своём любимом празднике; переведи слова.
steps: Nikita likes his birthday. I like New Year because I get presents.
New Year — Новый год, Father Frost — Дед Мороз, New Year tree — ёлка, present — подарок.
problems.answer: Nikita — birthday; New Year, Father Frost, New Year tree, present

problems.condition: Урок 15, упр. 11, с. 8. Прочитай историю и повтори за диктором.
steps: Dasha: Hello, Vera! Happy New Year! Vera: Hello, Dasha! Happy New Year! Come in. — How are you? — Fine, thanks.
problems.answer: Happy New Year! Come in. How are you? — Fine, thanks.

problems.condition: Урок 15, упр. 12, с. 9. Разыграй текст упр. 11 по ролям.
steps: A: Hello, Vera! Happy New Year! B: Hello, Dasha! Happy New Year! Come in. A: How are you? B: Fine, thank you.
problems.answer: Happy New Year! — Come in.

problems.condition: Урок 16, упр. 1, с. 10. Послушай, повтори фразы и скажи, почему покраснел Бен.
steps: Ben's face is red because he dropped the fruit and vegetables. — Бен покраснел, потому что уронил фрукты и овощи.
problems.answer: Бен уронил фрукты и овощи

problems.condition: Урок 16, упр. 2, с. 11. Прочитай текст по ролям и назови цвета одежды героев.
steps: yellow, red, green, purple, blue, pink.
problems.answer: yellow, red, green, purple, blue, pink

problems.condition: Урок 16, упр. 3, с. 12. Послушай и покажи на рисунке, о чём говорят герои.
steps: The car is green. The bus is red. The cat is black. The watch is purple. The jacket is pink. The dog is brown. The plane is white. The jumper is orange. The house is blue.
problems.answer: car — green, bus — red, cat — black, watch — purple, jacket — pink, dog — brown, plane — white, jumper — orange, house — blue

problems.condition: Урок 16, упр. 4, с. 12. Задай вопросы к картинкам и ответь по образцу.
steps: What's this? — It's a car. What colour is it? — It's green.
What's this? — It's a jumper. What colour is it? — It's orange.
What's this? — It's a bus. What colour is it? — It's red.
problems.answer: What's this? — It's a … What colour is it? — It's …

problems.condition: Урок 16, упр. 5, с. 12. Сыграй в игру по образцу.
steps: Tell me the name of something blue. — The sky is blue. Tell me the name of something black. — My cat is black. Tell me the name of something pink. — The ball is pink.
problems.answer: Tell me the name of something … — The … is …

problems.condition: Урок 16, упр. 6, с. 13. Найди в словарике значения новых слов.
steps: sun — солнце, sea — море, sky — небо, rainbow — радуга.
problems.answer: sun, sea, sky, rainbow

problems.condition: Урок 16, упр. 7, с. 13. Послушай песенку и подпевай.
steps: Песня о том, какими цветами можно раскрасить радугу, глаза, солнце, море.
problems.answer: Песня «Can you colour a rainbow?»

problems.condition: Урок 16, упр. 8, с. 13. Покажи солнце, небо, море, радугу и скажи, какого они цвета.
steps: The sun is yellow. The sky is blue. The sea is blue. The rainbow is red, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple.
problems.answer: sun — yellow; sky — blue; sea — blue; rainbow — red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple

problems.condition: Урок 16, упр. 9, с. 13. Какой твой любимый цвет? Спроси одноклассников.
steps: My favourite colour is pink. What is your favourite colour? — My favourite colour is blue.
problems.answer: My favourite colour is … What is your favourite colour?

problems.condition: Урок 16, упр. 10, с. 13. Прочитай и переведи предложения: какая форма у существительных и глагола?
steps: Bananas are yellow. — Бананы жёлтые. Oranges are orange. Apples are red. Cucumbers are green.
Существительные во множественном числе, глагол — are.
problems.answer: множественное число, are

problems.condition: Урок 16, упр. 11, с. 14. 1) Послушай и покажи рисунок к предложению; 2) где единственное, где множественное число.
steps: 1) The cats are black. The bear is brown. The fish are yellow.
2) множественное, единственное, множественное.
problems.answer: cats — мн., bear — ед., fish — мн.

problems.condition: Урок 16, упр. 12, с. 14. 1) От чего зависит произношение окончания -s; 2) какой звук в конце ед. числа.
steps: 1) От последнего звука слова: после глухих — /s/, после звонких и гласных — /z/, после шипящих — /ɪz/.
2) dog /g/, friend /d/, flag /g/, king /ŋ/, cat /t/, rat /t/, book /k/, boat /t/, horse /s/, orange /dʒ/, house /s/, bus /s/.
problems.answer: /s/ после глухих, /z/ после звонких, /ɪz/ после шипящих

problems.condition: Урок 16, упр. 13, с. 15. Как читается буква Y в открытом слоге?
steps: /aɪ/: sky, my, fly.
problems.answer: /aɪ/ — sky

problems.condition: Урок 16, упр. 14, с. 15. Прочитай транскрипцию, раздели слово на слоги: на какой слог ударение?
steps: gym-nast: ударение на первый слог. Слог gym — закрытый, Y в нём читается /ɪ/.
problems.answer: закрытый слог — /ɪ/

problems.condition: Урок 16, упр. 15, с. 15. Послушай и прочитай слова.
steps: /aɪ/ fly, my, try, sky; /ɪ/ gymnast, Sydney, system; /i/ easy, body, very.
problems.answer: fly, my, try, sky, gymnast, Sydney, system, easy, body, very

problems.condition: Урок 16, упр. 16, с. 15. Послушай текст и повтори.
steps: Читаем текст о цветах вслед за диктором.
problems.answer: Прослушать и повторить.

problems.condition: Урок 17, упр. 1, с. 16. Прочитай и повтори диалог.
steps: Is this your street? — Yes. This is number one. Miss Fisher lives here. This is number three. — Who lives here? — Mr Green.
problems.answer: Is this your street? Who lives here?

problems.condition: Урок 17, упр. 2, с. 17. Прочитай диалог по ролям.
steps: A: Is this your street? B: Yes. This is number one. Miss Fisher lives here. A: Who lives at number three? B: Mr Green.
problems.answer: … lives at number …

problems.condition: Урок 17, упр. 3, с. 18. Послушай и скажи, кто живёт во втором доме.
steps: Jenny lives at number two.
problems.answer: Jenny

problems.condition: Урок 17, упр. 4, с. 18. Рассмотри конверты и скажи, где живут эти люди.
steps: Tom lives at number 9 Lime Avenue. Miss Fisher lives at number 1. Ben lives at number 6. Jenny lives at number 2. Mr Green lives at number 3.
problems.answer: Tom — 9, Miss Fisher — 1, Ben — 6, Jenny — 2, Mr Green — 3 Lime Avenue

problems.condition: Урок 17, упр. 5, с. 18. Нарисуй улицу с домами друзей и напиши адреса по примеру.
steps: Tom Robinson, 9 Lime Avenue, Newtown. Masha Ivanova, 5 Sadovaya Street, Moscow.
problems.answer: Имя, номер дома и улица, город

problems.condition: Урок 17, упр. 6, с. 19. 1) Прочитай и переведи письмо; 2) как меняются окончания глаголов с местоимениями.
steps: 1) Дорогой Бен! Я Максим, живу во Владимире. Никита — мой лучший друг, он живёт в Москве. Его сестра живёт в Сочи.
2) С he, she, it глагол получает окончание -s: lives.
problems.answer: he / she / it + -s

problems.condition: Урок 17, упр. 7, с. 19. Прочитай текст и закончи его.
steps: I live at number 10 Petrovka Street, Moscow.
problems.answer: I live at number … Street, …

problems.condition: Урок 17, упр. 8, с. 19. Замени подчёркнутые существительные местоимениями.
steps: he, she, he, she, they, we.
problems.answer: he, she, he, she, they, we

problems.condition: Урок 17, упр. 9, с. 20. Послушай и прочитай стихотворение.
steps: Bees live in the garden, birds live in the tree. A mouse lives in our classroom, and fish live in the sea.
problems.answer: Пчёлы — в саду, птицы — на дереве, мышка — в классе, рыбки — в море.

problems.condition: Урок 17, упр. 10, с. 20. Соотнеси картинки с предложениями из стихотворения.
steps: Bees live in the garden. Birds live in the tree. Fish live in the sea. A mouse lives in our classroom.
problems.answer: live / lives

problems.condition: Урок 17, упр. 11, с. 20. 1) Закончи предложения; 2) замени существительные на it или they.
steps: 1) Bees live in the garden. Birds live in the tree. A mouse lives in our house. Fish live in the sea.
2) They, they, it, it, it.
problems.answer: they, they, it, it, it

problems.condition: Урок 17, упр. 12, с. 21. Настольная игра: ответь на вопросы.
steps: No, it isn't. No, it isn't. Yes, it is. Yes, it is. No, it isn't. Yes, it is. No, it isn't. Yes, it is. No, it isn't. No, it isn't.
problems.answer: Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.

chapters.title: 18. В ванной паук. A spider in the bathroom

problems.condition: Урок 18, упр. 1, с. 22. Послушай комикс и повтори: как бы ты поступил?
steps: Yes! Because I don't like spiders! / No! Spiders are small and good. I like spiders!
problems.answer: I like / don't like spiders.

problems.condition: Урок 18, упр. 2, с. 23. Прочитай текст и разыграй по ролям.
steps: A: Help! Help! There's a spider! B: Where? A: In the bathroom. Come quickly! It's a big spider! B: Show me! A: Look! There it is!
problems.answer: There's a spider in the bathroom!

problems.condition: Урок 18, упр. 3, с. 24. Послушай и покажи на картинке комнаты.
steps: This is the hall. This is the living room. This is the kitchen. This is the bathroom. This is the bedroom.
problems.answer: hall, living room, kitchen, bathroom, bedroom

problems.condition: Урок 18, упр. 4, с. 24. Расскажи о доме Бена.
steps: This is Ben's house. This is the kitchen. It's a big room. This is the bathroom. It's a small room. This is the hall. This is the living room. It's beautiful. Ben has got four bedrooms.
problems.answer: This is Ben's house. This is the kitchen / bathroom / hall / living room.

problems.condition: Урок 18, упр. 5, с. 24. Найди животных в комнатах дома.
steps: There's a spider in the bathroom. There's a cat in the bedroom. There's a bee in the kitchen. There's a parrot in the living room. There's a dog in the hall.
problems.answer: spider — bathroom, cat — bedroom, bee — kitchen, parrot — living room, dog — hall

problems.condition: Урок 18, упр. 6, с. 25. Какие животные тебе нравятся, а какие нет?
steps: I like spiders, dogs, horses and bees. I don't like centipedes, snails and ants.
problems.answer: I like … I don't like …

problems.condition: Урок 18, упр. 7, с. 25. Послушай песенку и подпевай.
steps: Песня о том, что в ванной паук, в прихожей улитка, по стене ползёт сороконожка, в спальне пчела.
problems.answer: Песня «There's a spider in the bathroom»

problems.condition: Урок 18, упр. 8, с. 25. Найди в песне все помещения и животных: кто где.
steps: a spider — in the bathroom, in the garden; a snail — in the hall, in the bed; a centipede — on the wall; a bee — in the bedroom; an ant — in the hall.
problems.answer: spider — bathroom, snail — hall, centipede — wall, bee — bedroom, ant — hall

problems.condition: Урок 18, упр. 9, с. 26. Прочитай письмо Бена и покажи, где чья спальня.
steps: Eddy's room is purple. Ben's room is blue. Mary's room is yellow. Parents' room is pink with a red bed and a cat.
problems.answer: Eddy — purple, Ben — blue, Mary — yellow, parents — pink

problems.condition: Урок 18, упр. 10, с. 26. Переведи предложения.
steps: I'm from Russia. — Я из России. He's in Moscow. — Он в Москве. There's a dog in the hall. — В прихожей собака. There are four bedrooms in the house. — В доме четыре спальни.
problems.answer: Я из России. Он в Москве. В прихожей собака. В доме четыре спальни.

problems.condition: Урок 18, упр. 11, с. 26. Расшифруй и прочитай как можно больше предложений.
steps: I'm your friend. He's your friend. She's your friend. I'm from Russia. He's from Russia. She's from Russia. We're from Russia. They're from Russia.
problems.answer: I'm / He's / She's / We're / They're …

problems.condition: Урок 18, упр. 12, с. 27. Прочитай письмо и назови все помещения в квартире.
steps: There is a kitchen, a bathroom, a hall and two rooms — a living room and a bedroom.
problems.answer: kitchen, bathroom, hall, living room, bedroom

problems.condition: Урок 18, упр. 13, с. 27. Нарисуй свою квартиру и расскажи о ней.
steps: This is my flat. There are three rooms — a living room and two bedrooms. There is a kitchen, a bathroom and a hall. My bedroom is blue. There are two windows, a bed and a desk.
problems.answer: This is my flat. There are … rooms. There is a kitchen …

problems.condition: Урок 18, упр. 14, с. 27. Назови как можно больше предметов на рисунке квартиры.
steps: In the living room: a computer, two armchairs, a sofa, a TV, a dog. In the bedroom: two windows, a desk, a chair, a bed, a carpet, a wardrobe, a doll. In the kitchen: a table, chairs, a fridge.
problems.answer: computer, armchairs, sofa, TV, desk, chair, bed, carpet, wardrobe, table, fridge

chapters.title: 19. Я люблю улиток. I like snails

problems.condition: Урок 19, упр. 1, с. 28. Послушай и покажи, что есть на рисунках.
steps: a house, mountains, a road, a snail, a horse, a bird.
problems.answer: house, mountains, road, snail, horse, bird

problems.condition: Урок 19, упр. 2, с. 28. Послушай и угадай, где чей рисунок.
steps: Первый текст — картинка 2 (Jenny). Второй текст — картинка 1 (Tom).
problems.answer: 1 — Jenny (2), 2 — Tom (1)

problems.condition: Урок 19, упр. 3, с. 29. Чем отличаются картинки Тома и Дженни?
steps: There's a snail in Tom's picture. There isn't a snail in Jenny's picture. There's a horse in Tom's picture. There isn't a horse in Jenny's picture. There's a cat in Jenny's picture. There isn't a cat in Tom's picture.
problems.answer: There's a … in Tom's picture. There isn't a … in Jenny's picture.

problems.condition: Урок 19, упр. 4, с. 29. Прочитай подписи: что не так и кто на картинках?
steps: It's a dog. It's a snail. It's a horse. It's a bird. It's a cat. It's a spider.
problems.answer: dog, snail, horse, bird, cat, spider

problems.condition: Урок 19, упр. 5, с. 29. Составь предложения по образцу к рисункам упр. 4.
steps: It isn't a horse. It's a dog. It isn't a dog. It's a snail. It isn't a cat. It's a horse. It isn't a spider. It's a bird. It isn't a bird. It's a cat. It isn't a snail. It's a spider.
problems.answer: It isn't a … It's a …

problems.condition: Урок 19, упр. 6, с. 30. Что любит каждый из персонажей?
steps: Tom likes cars. Ben likes spiders. Elvis likes butterflies. Mary likes books. Sally likes presents. Jill likes dogs.
problems.answer: Tom — cars, Ben — spiders, Elvis — butterflies, Mary — books, Sally — presents, Jill — dogs

problems.condition: Урок 19, упр. 7, с. 30. Расскажи, что любят твои друзья.
steps: Olga likes cats. Sasha likes dogs. Alice likes books. Denis likes cars.
problems.answer: … likes …

problems.condition: Урок 19, упр. 8, с. 30. Нарисуй и напиши, что ты любишь, а что нет.
steps: I like dogs. I like presents. I don't like snails. I don't like spiders.
problems.answer: I like … I don't like …

problems.condition: Урок 19, упр. 9, с. 31. Найди ответ к каждой картинке и закончи фразу.
steps: This is not a queen. This is a king. The rose is not blue. It is pink. She is not from Russia. She's from Australia. He isn't her brother. He's her friend. There isn't a computer in the room. There's a TV.
problems.answer: This is not a … This is a …

problems.condition: Урок 19, упр. 10, с. 31. Угадай картинки по описанию и вставь номера.
steps: A) There isn't a snail in picture 3. There is a horse in this picture. B) There isn't a cat in picture 2. There are spiders in this picture. C) There isn't a horse in picture 1. There is a cat in this picture.

chapters.title: 20. Мне нравится пицца. I like pizza

problems.condition: Урок 20, упр. 1, с. 32. Послушай и повтори: кто в семье Бена больше всех любит поесть?
steps: Mary likes eating most of all.
problems.answer: Mary

problems.condition: Урок 20, упр. 2, с. 33. Послушай: что они любят из еды?
steps: Ben likes pizza. Grandma likes salad. Mary likes fish and chips. Dad likes sausages. Mum likes cheese.
problems.answer: Ben — pizza, Grandma — salad, Mary — fish and chips

problems.condition: Урок 20, упр. 3, с. 33. Спроси одноклассников, кто что любит из еды.
steps: What do you like? — I like pizza. What does Masha like? — She likes sandwiches.
problems.answer: What do you like? — I like … What does … like? — She likes …

problems.condition: Урок 20, упр. 4, с. 33. Разыграй диалоги: что тебе нравится из еды.
steps: Do you like eggs? — Yes, I do. Do you like sausages? — No, I don't. Do you like chips? — Yes, I do.
problems.answer: Do you like …? — Yes / No.

problems.condition: Урок 20, упр. 5, с. 34. Прочитай предложения и угадай, где чья еда для пикника.
steps: Mum likes salad and cheese — рисунок 4. Mary likes yoghurt, salad and sandwiches — рисунок 1. Ben likes chocolate and pizza — рисунок 2. Dad likes sausages and eggs — рисунок 3.
problems.answer: Mum — 4, Mary — 1, Ben — 2, Dad — 3

problems.condition: Урок 20, упр. 6, с. 34. Расскажи о каждом члене семьи Бена: кто что любит и не любит.
steps: Mary likes yoghurt, salad and sandwiches. She doesn't like fish. Ben likes pizza and chocolate. He doesn't like salad. Mum likes salad and cheese. Dad likes sausages.
problems.answer: … likes … He / she doesn't like …

problems.condition: Урок 20, упр. 7, с. 34. Нарисуй любимую еду и расскажи, что ты любишь.
steps: My favourite food is chicken. I like sandwiches and pizza, too. I don't like fish.
problems.answer: My favourite food is … I like … too.

problems.condition: Урок 20, упр. 8, с. 35. Расскажи, кто из ребят что любит.
steps: Dasha likes cats, snails, books, jam and skirts. Nikita likes dogs, spiders, jeans, nuts and vans. Vera likes cats, flowers and ice cream.
problems.answer: Dasha likes cats, snails, books…; Nikita likes dogs, spiders, jeans…

problems.condition: Урок 20, упр. 9, с. 35. Прочитай рассказ Веры о друзьях: что они любят, что нет?
steps: Dasha likes cats — I like cats too. She likes snails, but I don't like snails. She doesn't like cars, and I don't like cars either. Nikita likes dogs and spiders. He doesn't like snails.
problems.answer: Dasha — cats, snails; Nikita — dogs, spiders

problems.condition: Урок 20, упр. 10, с. 35. Расскажи по-английски о вкусах своих друзей.
steps: My friend Sasha likes ice cream and pizza, but she doesn't like milk. She likes dogs and flowers. She doesn't like spiders and snails.
problems.answer: My friend … likes … but doesn't like …

chapters.title: 21. Где же он? Where is it?

problems.condition: Урок 21, упр. 1, с. 36. Послушай диалог и прочитай вслух.
steps: Son: Mum, where's my scarf? Mum: In the wardrobe? Son: No! Mum: In the drawer? Son: No! Mum: Under the bed? Son: Yes! Here it is!
